hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: ABOUT US
intro.paragraph1: StarThermaTech (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a commercial space company dedicated to R&D, production, sales, and services for low-temperature plasma diagnostics and electric propulsion. We deliver reliable plasma measurement solutions with an engineering-focused, innovative team that spans R&D, systems engineering, market/application consulting, and close collaboration with BUAA, BIT, CAS, and other institutes.
intro.paragraph2: Our core members bring deep experience in space electric propulsion, plasma diagnostics, spectroscopy, instrument control, and algorithms. We support the full lifecycle—from requirements clarification and solution design to delivery, calibration, training, and long-term operations—so customers can deploy with confidence.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Provide stable, trustworthy diagnostics to help research and engineering teams understand, control, and apply plasma more efficiently—advancing propulsion and process technologies for space and industry.
